label: how a specific known thing is marked when it is marked at all: Marathi has no article
note: SPINE-DEFINITE-REFERENCE is an A1 spine node and the track omits its only concept, GRAMMAR-THE. The Spanish points on the definite and indefinite articles and their contractions do not transfer -- Marathi has no article system -- but the DEMAND behind the bare-noun point does: a reader must know that a bare Marathi noun can be either definite or indefinite and that context decides.
